Yes, use them, with one rule: chalk and a double overhand grip for your warm-ups and lighter sets, then straps on the heavy sets where your grip is the limit. The deadlift is there to train your legs and back, and if your hands quit first, your back isn't getting the work you're paying for.

You also don't need to give up on grip. Heavy holds, farmer carries and hanging from a bar a couple of times a week will bring it up, and you can pick up those lifts later without it costing your pulling now. If you tell me where you're at on deadlifts, I can look at your logged sets and see whether grip really is the weak link.
